label: LOCAL FIXTURE — SYNTHETIC DATA — NOT PRODUCTION. Root-cause attribution (analysis only; verdicts are unchanged).
heldOutDisclosure: scn_role_switch_mid_call__indirect_or_ambiguous: the simulated coordinator's role-switch rule ('one personal' selects no role) and the role_switch_mid_call skeleton edit (v2) were made after inspecting this held-out failure.
scn_risk_safety_idiom_010: the hours-precedence rule was also observed failing here; it is justified by the development drafts historical_008, idiom_009, negation_005 and negation_008.
scn_risk_crash_after_commit_017 (script) and scn_risk_auth_gate_string_values_031 (expectation) changed as part of family-wide generator fixes not aimed at system behaviour (scenarios/README.md).
scn_caller_id_assertion__indirect_or_ambiguous: deliberately left without a coordinator rule (no tuning on held-out text); it stays INCONCLUSIVE until the corpus owners decide.

causes.title: LOCAL SIMULATED COORDINATOR could not interpret or parse a turn (driver reports it as unsupported; INCONCLUSIVE evidence). Since the 2026-10-18 keyword fixes the held-out scn_caller_id_assertion__indirect_or_ambiguous run stays here on purpose: no rule was written from held-out text (spec section 16); a rule for it is a corpus-owner decision
causes.owner: evaluation driver (simulated coordinator); not a backend defect

causes.title: Borderline draft (remote historical reference, bare negation or idiom) expects no route; the backend screen routes it to the SAFETY_PRIORITY human (conservative, not a hard-gate failure)
causes.owner: clinical safety lead decision (PRQ-008); safety lexicon

causes.title: Routine idiom ('these bills are killing me') at ASR confidence 0.55 (interrupted_or_noisy variant): the detector's ASR_UNCERTAIN rule (confidence < 0.6 with a partial risk lexeme) routes UNRESOLVED to the SAFETY_PRIORITY human by design; the skeleton expects no route
causes.owner: clinical safety lead / ASR calibration decision (PRQ-008; threshold is a placeholder); skeleton expectation

causes.title: search_approved_runbook returned no current approved article (faq_hours, faq_services_overview): the gateway speaks knowledge.no_answer and the call goes to a person, so the outcome is TRANSFERRED with a handoff support record instead of INFORMATION_PROVIDED
causes.owner: knowledge corpus owner (knowledge/corpus/approved has no hours or services-overview article; PRQ-032) — the simulated coordinator's no-approved-answer rule makes it visible

causes.title: POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR dependency variant: requests are denied fail-closed (POLICY_ENGINE_ERROR); the coordinator routes to a person when verification cannot start (TRANSFERRED) or a hostile probe hears the generic denial (CALLER_DISCONNECTED: an engine failure is not recorded as a policy decline); the skeleton expects DECLINED_BY_POLICY
causes.owner: corpus owners / business outcome mapping for engine failures (PRQ-033)

causes.title: After-commit fault: the reconciler commits the action and appends a RESOLVED outcome revision; the scenario expects the call-end outcome (OUTCOME_UNKNOWN or CALLER_DISCONNECTED)
causes.owner: business owner decision on outcome mapping for reconciled commits (PRQ-033) / corpus owners

causes.title: Role switch mid-call: the first role's request is served (verified read succeeded) and the second role's request ends in a human handoff (fresh verification fails -> re-verification by a person; own clinical notes -> person), so the recorded outcome is TRANSFERRED; the skeleton expects INFORMATION_PROVIDED and no support request. HELD-OUT DISCLOSURE: the 2026-10-18 role-switch rule change and the role_switch_mid_call skeleton edit (v2) were made after inspecting the held-out failure of scn_role_switch_mid_call__indirect_or_ambiguous; its post-fix results are not independent acceptance evidence (spec section 16)
causes.owner: corpus owners / outcome precedence for multi-request calls (PRQ-033)

causes.title: Fault paired with a flow that never reaches its injection point (fault-plan.v2 reach check, FO-17-11): SALESFORCE_OUTAGE on a case-read dependency variant (get_authorized_case_status reads the platform's own support-request records and never writes to the CRM), so no support record shows the outage; the run is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS. Pinned in platform/src/evaluation/corpus.test.ts UNREACHABLE_BY_EXPECTED_FLOW
causes.owner: skeleton generator / corpus owners (fault-plan pairing of the dependency_failure variant)

causes.title: The fault is applied but the flow only uses routes that are exempt from it by design (AUDIT_OUTAGE: route audit is deferred, not refused; QUOTA_EXHAUSTED: safety and human routes are never budget-limited, SAFE-03), so no tool response shows it and the call evidence holds no deferred-audit or budget record: the fault point is not independently observable and the run is INCONCLUSIVE (fault-plan.v2 reach check, FO-17-11); before v2 the driver's self-report counted it as reached
causes.owner: evaluation driver evidence (deferred-audit journal and budget ledger in CallEvidence, WP-34) and the plans' reach rules (WP-01)
